name: localboard
description: Local-first project dashboard, agent activity, and personal todo tools.

interface.shortDescription: Report agent work and manage local personal todos.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex and ChatGPT to the LocalBoard desktop dashboard. It reports the current execution path and manages global or Git-repository personal todos without sending private data to a remote LocalBoard service.
